name: secret-paste-guard
title: Secret Paste Guard
description: Wraps a text field and scans its value for known key formats (AWS, GitHub, Stripe, Slack, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, JWTs, private keys) plus long high-entropy strings, offering Redact (keeps the last 4) or Keep.

meta.stops: Helps catch an API key pasted into a chat
meta.summary: Spots API keys, tokens and private keys as they're pasted or typed into a field and offers one-tap Redact before they're sent.
meta.server: Scan again server-side before storing or forwarding text, and redact secrets from logs, analytics and error reports.
catches: Known formats: private key blocks, AWS access keys, GitHub tokens, Stripe live/restricted keys, Slack, OpenAI, Anthropic and Google API keys, JWTs
Long mixed-case-and-digit strings with high Shannon entropy (marked as a guess)
URL paths are not mistaken for secrets, but tokens in query strings can be
limits: Pattern and entropy based: new or unusual formats are missed, and random IDs can be flagged
Scans in the browser only; it does not stop a submit, so a user can Keep and send
onDetect receives the matched text, so never log or send those matches as-is
a11y: Warning renders in a polite live region
Redact and Keep are labelled buttons
After either choice, focus returns to the wrapped field
